subject.title: Plugin context engines cannot increment /status compaction count

question: Which plugin-facing compaction reporting contract should OpenClaw support for context engines that own compaction: an `afterTurn` notification callback, an `afterTurn` result shape, or a status/stats query surface?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the fix changes the public context-engine/plugin lifecycle contract and needs maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Add an afterTurn callback
options.body: Pass a narrow callback in `afterTurn` and maintenance params so engines can increment the canonical session counter only after successful owned compactions.

options.title: Return compaction metadata
options.body: Allow `afterTurn` or maintenance to return a small result object, but this broadens existing lifecycle signatures for plugin implementations.

options.title: Query engine stats
options.body: Let status query an optional engine stats method, but reconcile carefully so it does not create a second source of truth beside session state.

recommendation.title: Add an afterTurn callback
recommendation.body: Pass a narrow callback in `afterTurn` and maintenance params so engines can increment the canonical session counter only after successful owned compactions.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is on the context-engine plugin API contract that jalehman introduced and later extended.
